That evening she lit the lamp early, and, for the first time in years, she smiled at the dark water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市在沉睡与苏醒之间徘徊。路灯投下昏黄的光，像一圈圈疲倦的梦。街道空旷，只有清洁工的扫帚声沙沙作响，远处早点铺的蒸笼升起第一缕白雾。高楼的窗口大多漆黑，偶尔亮起一盏灯，是夜班归来的人，或是早起奔忙的人。风带着露水的凉意掠过天桥，红绿灯仍在无人的路口认真地变换。天边泛起一线淡淡的青灰，新的一天正悄悄逼近，而这座城市还来不及开口，便已深深呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a Russian nesting doll that has a smaller doll inside.\n- Each copy keeps passing the job to a smaller one until it reaches a tiny version so simple that you can answer it right away, like the smallest doll that does not open.\n- Then all the answers get passed back up, one step at a time, until the first big job is finished."}
